notes:
- **Your agent's first questions start with the first thing you type.** The first screen has a
  message box, and the questions ask what your days look like and where you keep your work. Archie
  for Teams starts with a pack of its own.
- **Written setups for four lines of work: portable restrooms, restroom trailers for events, home
  trades, and real estate.** Each holds the lists that work runs on and a few rules a new hire would
  hear on day one, and you can change any of it by asking.
- **Lists keep their stages and sit in your agent's sidebar.** The Dashboard shows each list with a
  bar of where its entries stand, and a list says how many are entered out of how many in all. Ask in
  the chat and your agent sets up a list's stages itself.
- **Bring a spreadsheet into a list** by dropping it in the chat, or with Import on the list itself,
  on the Knowledge tab, under Lists. Archie names any cells it could not read and never adds the
  same unit twice.
- **Entries your agent reads off a photo, a page, or your calendar go on one card you check.** Press
  Add and they go on the list as one job, with one Undo.
- **Under each reply, what your agent saved and what it read**, with Open and Undo. The top of the
  Knowledge tab shows what your agent keeps.
- **Your agent keeps your business's name, prices, phone number, and sign-off** and uses them in
  what it writes. When a draft needs a detail nobody gave, it leaves a blank, and an email or text
  with a blank in it will not send until you fill it in.
- **Ask who owes you money** and your agent answers from your lists, the chat, and its notes. Ask who
  to call and it works that out from your People and Deals lists.
- **Ask what's on, what's due, or what's free on some days**, and your agent looks at your lists,
  calendar, and reminders for those days before it answers. The Calendar shows the dates on your
  lists, and Archie tells you when a booking puts a trailer or a unit in two places at once, whether
  your agent saved it or you typed it on the Knowledge tab, under Lists.
- **Every reminder shows on your to-do list**, and deleting it in either place takes it off both.
  When a reminder goes off, Remind me later lets you pick any time, and each button says what it
  does.
- **Right-click an agent** to open it, start or stop it, rename it, change how it looks, or delete it.
- **New chat starts over with one press**, and a line marks where each day and each new chat begins.
- **Edit it opens a pop-up** that shows the message your draft answers. Rewrite it for me takes more
  from you, and looks things up when you point it at them.
- **When the AI your agent thinks with runs out, it says so once**, with the ways to keep going, and
  keeps what you send until the AI is back.
- **When the AI company fails, Archie asks it once more** before showing anything, says whether
  anything was saved or sent, and puts Try again under the reply.
- **A reply that says your calendar or email is not connected has a button under it** that opens
  where to connect it.
- **The price is on the trial strip, the AI account panel, and a new Your plan row on the Account
  page.** A plan with no AI in it asks for your AI account right after you buy it.
- **Two new guides: where your information goes, and what Archie connects to.**
- **A stopped agent says who stopped it and when.**
- **On Archie for Teams, the people you add are teammates.** Write down who each one is and what they
  do, and your agent knows its team. A button beside each teammate shows what they can see and
  change, and the Dashboard shows what each did this week. A teammate can set and cancel their own
  reminders, and asking about the work gets them their own entries and the ones nobody is named on.
- **A backup from Archie opens in Archie for Teams**, so you can move your agents over when you hire.
- **Your agent is told never to pass on new or changed payment instructions**, even when you ask, and
  to tell you to confirm by phone at a number you already have. It is an instruction to the AI, and
  an AI can get it wrong, so read anything about moving money yourself.
- **Fixed: a reply could say it saved something to your lists when nothing was saved.** A note under
  it says so now, with a Save it button.
- **Fixed: the buttons on your agent's question cards stopped working when Archie restarted.** They
  last two weeks now.
- **Fixed: a reply could include your agent's notes to itself between searches.**
- **Fixed: questions about your own work could go to the web researcher**, which reads only the one
  message it gets. Fewer do now.
